1.outfitText: - HYKE PERTEX logger coat: a matte khaki-beige (warm sand-brown) technical shell with a smooth, faintly crisp surface. A tall funnel stand collar standing up around her neck, a covered front placket closed with a few small matte snaps, raglan sleeves, two large chest patch pockets under wide snapped flaps, a straight easy body falling to mid-calf, a drawcord hem with small toggles at the sides. Worn CLOSED all the way up to the collar. Both arms are inside the sleeves; the hands come out of the cuffs. The same khaki-beige outside and at every edge. - HYKE lambswool sweater: charcoal-grey soft wool crew neck; only a narrow band of grey knit shows inside the stand collar. - HYKE TA wide leg pants: black, matte, fluid, very wide straight legs with front pleats, full length, the hem falling over the boots so only the toes and the chunky soles show. - FABIO RUSCONI side-gore short boots: black smooth leather, round toe, black elastic side gores, a thick black lug tank sole. Mostly hidden under the trouser hem; never a close-up of the boots. No bag, no jewellery, no scarf, no hat, no gloves.

2.outfitText: - HYKE double-faced faux shearling pea coat: deep navy double-faced wool, collarless round neck. A large rectangular bib of curly navy faux shearling covers the chest and the tops of the shoulders like a yoke. Below it, double-breasted with SIX black buttons in two rows, ALL buttoned closed. Two long vertical welt pockets at the chest edges, two flap pockets at the hips, wide rounded sleeves, a long straight body falling just below the knee. Both arms are inside the sleeves; the hands come out of the cuffs. - HYKE broad long shirt: a clear mid-blue cotton shirt with a pointed collar; the blue collar comes out at the neck above the shearling bib, a narrow blue cuff shows below each coat sleeve, and its long hem hangs OUT a little below the coat hem as a band of blue. - HYKE denim tapered jeans: dark raw indigo rigid denim, almost navy-black, high waist, curved barrel legs that taper to the ankle, the hem resting on the top of the boots. - FABIO RUSCONI side-gore short boots: black smooth leather, round toe, black elastic side gores, a pull tab front and back, a black lug sole. No bag, no jewellery, no scarf, no hat, no gloves.

3.outfitText: - HYKE double-faced trench coat: warm camel double-faced wool with a soft brushed surface. Collarless round neck, a squared storm flap over the right shoulder and chest, the front wraps across and fastens with a self-fabric belt and a small dark buckle at her right side, the belt end hanging down. Huge rounded cocoon sleeves that balloon out from the shoulder and narrow at the cuff. Long and straight, falling to mid-calf. Worn CLOSED with that side belt. Both arms are inside the sleeves; the hands come out of the cuffs. Camel at every edge, no lapels. - HYKE ribbed zip sweater: chocolate-brown chunky rib knit, zipped all the way up, its big ribbed funnel collar standing up around her neck above the round neck of the coat, a small silver zip pull at the throat. - HYKE TA wide leg pants: ecru cream, matte and fluid, very wide straight legs with front pleats, full length, pooling over the boots. - FABIO RUSCONI square-toe short boots: smooth leather in a muted oak taupe (grey-brown), square toe, a low block heel; only the square toes show under the cream trousers. No bag, no jewellery, no scarf, no hat, no gloves.

pages.location: outdoors on the black sand beach of Reynisfjara on the south coast of Iceland, as in the location photo: fine black volcanic sand and smooth black pebbles, the cliff of tall grey hexagonal basalt columns stepping down to the beach like a giant stair, the Reynisdrangar sea stacks standing in the grey Atlantic, white surf. No other people near her, no signs, no readable text, no logos, no flags, no shop names. No other visitors, no trees.
pages.situation: She stands on the very edge of the column top with BOTH boots firmly planted, weight in one hip, both hands deep in the pockets of the closed khaki coat; the wind lifts her hair and the coat hem.
pages.film: Leica M6, Summicron 35mm, Kodak Vision3 500T cinema negative with a bleach-bypass process, handheld. A greyish, desaturated image with a cool blue-grey cast through the shadows and midtones: colours are muted to about half strength, reds and greens are dull, skin is pale and cool, blacks are dense, highlights are clean and slightly silvery. Visible fine grain. It looks overcast-cool even in sunlig

pages.situation: She stands in the sea wind, shoulders square, one hand gripping the edge of the tall funnel collar.
pages.film: i-D magazine street editorial. Shot on a compact 35mm film camera with an on-camera DIRECT FLASH fired straight at her from the front, even in daylight: her face and coat are hard-lit and bright with a crisp flash shadow just behind her, while the overcast place behind her falls a stop darker. Kodak Portra 800, visible grain, punchy natural colour, slight flash falloff at the edges. Raw, immediate

No other people near her, no signs, no readable text, no logos, no flags, no shop names. No names or numbers on the hulls: any lettering on the boats is out of frame or melted into blur. No cars, no trees.
